newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras still a buy.

text.p: -- Caspian Securities said in a report it reiterated its buy rating on Brazilian federal telecoms holding Telebras but said its $150 ADR price target "could prove a bit conservative."
-- Caspian analyst Tony Figueiredo cited progress on Brazil's new telecoms law, upcoming cellular B Band concessions, recent tariff rebalancing and government commitment to privatization.
-- The auction of Cia Vale do Rio Doce this week despite a stream of court injunctions "highlights Brazil's commitment to privatization, including that of Telebras," Figueiredo wrote.
